professionalSummary: Experienced onboarding analyst with a proven track record of processing private client and family trust cases, managing compliance checklists, and delivering weekly ageing reports. Holds an International Certificate in Anti Money Laundering and has led training for new joiners.
experienceHighlights: Processed onboarding cases for private clients and family trusts at Calder Row Wealth, collecting identity and source‑of‑wealth documents and preparing each file for compliance review.
Rewrote the onboarding document checklist with the compliance officer after the 2023 policy update, splitting it into separate lists for individuals, trusts and charities.
Built a weekly ageing report in the case management system showing open cases by stage and days outstanding, sent to the onboarding manager every Monday.
Took part in the compliance team's quarterly file reviews, pulling the sampled files and recording missing documents for remediation.
Trained four new joiners on the case management system and the revised checklists.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Revised two‑page checklist for family trusts, listing the trust deed, the register of beneficial owners, identity documents for each trustee and the source‑of‑wealth questions, with the policy section that each item comes from.
